tables.name: business_setup
tables.description: The fields of FS line 721 that K-04 core's businesses row does not hold, one row per business beside it: the listing's phone and email, website, About us, the profile's confirmation, the Stripe account, no money through Rosie, the terms accepted and by whom, and how control of the business was proven. Core keeps id, name (B01), display_name (B02), status, time_zone, text hours (H04) and version; this row never repeats them.
tables.source: FS line 721; 02-contracts section 7 row K-23; K-04 v1 businesses (CQ-03)

columns.name: business_id
columns.description: The business (businesses.id); one setup row per business.
columns.source: FS line 721 (business.id); arch 10 line 546

columns.name: listing_phone
columns.description: The business's own phone from its public listing, in E.164 form (B04). It stays the business's: customers book through Rosie's one number, and Rosie uses it only for the control code and the go-live notice. Null: no listed phone.
columns.source: FS row B04; FS line 721 (listing_phone); S1-09; S1-75; S1-35; D102

columns.name: listing_email
columns.description: The email on the public listing, in lower case: where the control code and the go-live notice go while there are no calls or texts to the listing (Q-02's default). Null: the listing has no email, so Rosie's team checks control.
columns.source: Q-02 default; S1-75 ('the listing's own phone or email'); S1-35 ('the phone and email on the public listing'); FS row B15

columns.name: website
columns.description: The website or listing link (B05), read to draft About us and the photos; not shown.
columns.source: FS row B05; FS line 721 (website); S1-09; S1-84

columns.name: about
columns.description: The About us line (B06), drafted from the listing or website or written by the owner; go-live waits for it. Null until drafted.
columns.source: FS row B06; FS line 721 (about); S1-84; FS section 10

columns.name: profile_confirmed_at
columns.description: When the owner confirmed About us and the photos in one answer (S1-84 gives profile). Null: nothing shows yet (S1-84's safe default).
columns.source: S1-84 (gives profile; 'nothing shows until Sam confirms'); FS rows B06, B07

columns.name: stripe_account_id
columns.description: The business's own Stripe account (M01), connected at S1-27; money lands there, never with Rosie. Null: not connected, or no money through Rosie. Its form is K-14's.
columns.source: FS row M01; FS line 721 (stripe_account_id); S1-27 (gives stripe); K-14

columns.name: no_money

columns.name: terms_accepted_at

columns.description: The owner who ticked them (persons.id); never a helper, whose yes is not the owner's.

columns.name: control_proven_at
columns.description: When control of the business was proven (B15), the go-live gate of S1-75; null: not yet, so the business stays offline.

columns.name: control_proven_via
columns.description: listing_code: a code sent to the listing's own contact came back right; team_check: Rosie's team checked it (S1-75's two branches).

tables.name: flow_defaults
tables.description: The business's default free-cancel time (H06) and arrival setting (H07), one row per flow it offers: A, the customer comes to the business; B, the business goes to the customer. Each starts from the plug-in's pf.settings (cutoff, arrive), which may differ by flow, and the owner keeps or changes it at S1-21. A booking copies its free-cancel time in when it is made (K-30's cutoff_at), so a change applies to new bookings only.
tables.source: FS rows H06, H07; FS line 721 (default cutoff, default arrive); FS line 746 (pf.settings in typed columns); S1-21; fixtures/v1/test-kit/shops (settings per flow)

columns.name: business_id
columns.description: The business (businesses.id).
columns.source: FS line 721

columns.name: flow
columns.description: A or B, as K-04's bookings.flow.
columns.source: FS line 729 (flow); FS row H07 ('choice per flow'); master-A.json, master-B.json

columns.name: cutoff_before
columns.description: A free-cancel time counted back from the visit's start, such as 24 hours or 2 days before (H06). Null when cutoff_day_before_at gives it.
columns.source: FS row H06; pf.settings.cutoff ('24 hours before', '2 days before', '72 hours before' in fixture set v1's shops); A7-01

columns.name: cutoff_day_before_at
columns.description: A free-cancel time at a clock time on the day before the visit, in the business's zone, such as 6pm the day before (H06). Null when cutoff_before gives it.
columns.source: FS row H06; pf.settings.cutoff ('6pm the day before', '8pm the day before' in fixture set v1's shops)

columns.name: arrive
columns.description: The arrival setting (H07): setstart, a set start time; window, an arrival window.
columns.source: FS row H07; pf.settings.arrive (setstart, window); B4-83

columns.name: version
columns.description: The row's version: every update raises it by one, and a commit compares and sets it, so a write made from an old read is refused with the rows that changed (limit 4).
columns.source: arch 01 line 85; arch 10 line 506; K-04 v1 rule 2

checks.source: FS row H06 (R: one free-cancel time)

checks.name: flow_defaults_cutoff_before_positive
checks.expression: cutoff_before is null or cutoff_before > interval '0'
